cannon:

Pixel art, strict hard stair-step edges, limited palette charcoal black #111722, iron slate #303b49, sparse cool grey highlights, near-black outlines 3-4 pixels, strong readable squat silhouette. NO brass telescope silhouette, NO thin long tube, NO labels, NO words, NO background, NO ground, NO cast shadow outside sprites, NO assembled reference cannon.
Sheet arrangement: two rows, each row three ISOLATED SEPARATE components, each has a wide transparent gap. Row1 design A compact classic iron siege cannon. Row2 design B chunky naval iron cannon. In EACH row left cell: ONLY short fat horizontal barrel facing LEFT, huge dark muzzle at far left with a thick wide reinforcing lip, broad tapering barrel terminating in rounded closed breech at right and tiny rear knob. Ratio barrel length to thickness about 2.4:1, no wheels on barrel. Center cell: ONLY low fixed carriage/base with TWO CLEARLY VISIBLE large iron-rimmed solid dark wheels, near wheel prominent, far wheel offset to left, heavy stepped steel mounting cheeks and chunky dark oak or steel bed, no barrel. Right cell: ONLY small circular iron trunnion axle cap, facing viewer, to cover pivot. All components independent and level, exact side view, same scale within row, no perspective rotation. Clear isolated shapes fill their cells. Row1 and2 evenly distributed in a 3-column by2-row sheet. Transparent alpha background. High-quality manually designed 16bit sprite art, not photorealistic, no gradients or smooth airbrush.
